one_liner: Build tools and automations that create pages, organize data, and share feedback in Notion.

auth.notes: Supports OAuth 2.0 flows and bearer tokens (personal access tokens for user-scoped auth, internal connection tokens for connection-scoped auth). Both use Bearer header format.

evidence.snippet: Personal access token authentication Personal access tokens (PATs) are created directly by a Notion user in the Developer portal
OAuth integrations follow the OAuth 2.0 protocol to authorize a connection to interact with a workspace.
include the API token in the Authorization header with every API request.

access.notes: Free Notion accounts can create personal access tokens or internal integrations without approval. Business/Enterprise plans may require admin approval for PAT creation. No dedicated sandbox; developers use their own workspace.

evidence.snippet: A personal access token (PAT) lets you authenticate API requests as yourself without setting up
Use a personal access token for scripts, tools, and Workers that run with your Notion permissions.
On Business and Enterprise plans, PAT creation is restricted by default. Ask a workspace owner

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Per-connection: 600 req/min (Business/Enterprise) or 180 req/min (others). Per-workspace shared limit. Data source queries ~3 req/sec per connection.

evidence.snippet: Send requests over HTTPS to https://api.notion.com
Webhooks let your connection receive real-time updates from Notion.
The Notion API enforces two rate limits: a per-connection limit and a per-workspace limit.
